title: A delivery order under the minimum
description: Eight pounds twenty against a fifteen pound minimum. The refusal is not a
dead end — it comes back with the shortfall so the agent can say how much
short they are and offer to add something, which is the difference between
a rule that loses the order and one that grows it.
The minimum applies to delivery and not to collection, which is why this
scenario is a delivery one. A collection order of the same basket goes
through, and that asymmetry is deliberate: nobody turns away a customer
standing at the counter for spending too little.
caller: You want a chicken pitta and a bottle of water, delivered to 3 Hanbury Street,
E1 6QR. Your name is Toby Lawrence and your number is 07700 900377.
If you are told there is a minimum order, you are not willing to spend more —
ask whether you can collect instead.

criteria.name: Said how much short the order was
goal: The agent told the caller there was a minimum for delivery and said how much they
were short by, or what the minimum is, rather than only refusing.

criteria.name: Offered a way forward
goal: The agent offered something the caller could do about it — adding to the order, or
collecting instead — rather than ending the conversation at the refusal.
